required_skills.text: Four or more years of professional SEO experience with meaningful ecommerce responsibility.
Demonstrated success increasing qualified organic traffic, conversions, or ecommerce revenue.
Experience owning both strategy and daily execution and carrying projects through implementation, verification, and measurement.
Experience with large product catalogs and complex ecommerce site structures.
Strong technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, internal linking, site architecture, and structured-data knowledge.
Experience with backlink, external-linking, digital PR, or off-site authority strategy.
Independent execution, detailed maintenance, cross-department collaboration, mentoring, adaptability, and strong judgment.
Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
Familiarity with AI-powered search and practical generative-AI use in SEO workflows.

preferred_skills.text: Direct ecommerce SEO experience is required. Working knowledge of Magento is a strong plus.
Magento or Magento 2; direct product, category, and content updates in an ecommerce platform.
Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity; repeatable AI prompts, workflows, custom tools, or automation.
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, SQL, APIs, Python, automation, and data-analysis tools.
Product feeds, Google Merchant Center, ecommerce analytics, conversion tracking, redesigns, migrations, platform changes, and large-scale content updates.
Healthcare, medical supplies, durable medical equipment, or other regulated-industry experience.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, computer science, communications, or a related field.

responsibilities.text: Own organic-search and AI-search strategy and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on customer value, revenue potential, impact, risk, and effort.
Take initiatives from research and diagnosis through implementation, testing, measurement, and maintenance.
Personally execute improvements when access and skills allow.
Establish goals, benchmarks, and KPIs; report priorities, risks, results, and next steps to leadership.
Adapt priorities to performance, business objectives, algorithm changes, competitor activity, technical issues, and customer behavior.
Improve product data, categories, manufacturer pages, product relationships, attributes, navigation, and discoverability.
Establish SEO standards and repeatable processes for adding, updating, organizing, and discontinuing products.
Improve product/category names, descriptions, metadata, images, attributes, and internal links.
Determine when pages should be created, optimized, consolidated, redirected, canonicalized, or removed.
Work directly with catalog staff, review changes for quality, and create scalable templates and documentation.
Partner with developers to improve crawling, indexing, architecture, page speed, Core Web Vitals, canonicalization, redirects, structured data, XML sitemaps, and robots directives.
Address filters, faceted navigation, pagination, product variants, duplicate content, and complex URLs.
Define technical requirements, support implementation, test deployments, monitor releases, and remain accountable for SEO outcomes.
Audit and correct broken links, 404s, redirect chains, duplicate content, canonical tags, indexing problems, metadata, headings, images, schema, and internal links.
Find orphaned, underlinked, outdated, competing, and underperforming pages.
Diagnose changes in traffic, rankings, indexing, conversions, and revenue.
Conduct keyword, competitor, content-gap, search-intent, and customer-question research.
Optimize product, category, manufacturer, brand, and informational pages.
Scale SEO across thousands of catalog pages while preventing cannibalization and unnecessary duplication.
Connect organic work to qualified traffic, conversions, revenue, customer value, and the full buying journey.
Develop content supporting product research and purchase, including category pages, medical conditions, comparisons, buying guides, FAQs, and customer questions.
Create or edit content and actionable briefs; establish accuracy, sourcing, citation, and review standards for medical information.
Own backlink, external-linking, outreach, digital PR, and off-site authority strategy with manufacturers, suppliers, associations, publishers, and partners.
Monitor new, lost, broken, low-quality, or harmful links; reclaim links and unlinked mentions while following search-engine guidelines.
Improve visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI assistants, answer engines, and emerging discovery platforms through content structure, entity signals, structured data, citations, and authority.
Use AI tools for research, content analysis, briefs, internal linking, reporting, workflows, and automation while enforcing quality and medical-content review standards.
Mentor catalog, content, technical, merchandising, and marketing staff through hands-on work.
Create checklists, templates, training materials, and quality-control processes.
Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, backlinks, AI visibility, and other KPIs.
Build reporting that connects SEO activity to business outcomes and explain results to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
A clear, collaboratively developed SEO strategy and roadmap that turns into measurable completed work.
Initiatives move from discovery through implementation without stalling after recommendations.
Catalog and technical teams understand current priorities and make better SEO decisions.
Technical, content, internal-linking, and authority improvements are consistently maintained.
Product, category, manufacturer, and informational pages gain organic visibility.
Vitality Medical gains authority in traditional and AI-powered search.
Organic search produces measurable growth in qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue.
Leadership receives clear reporting on completed work, results, opportunities, risks, and next steps.
**Work location:** Hybrid remote in Salt Lake City, UT 84121.

evidence.quote: Examples of analysis projects: analyzed max CPC vs smart-bidding, omni-channel brand-holdouts, CPC optimization for Brand, non-brand target CPA, AI-assisted promotion analysis using Namogoo, incremental CPA analysis on scale-up/down, audience analysis in Google Ads to test and apply to other platforms, Data-Driven Attribution analysis (DDA), Lifetime Value of Customer (LTV) analysis, affiliate commission analysis and discount negotiation, Performance Max/Google Shopping mixture analysis, 5- year projections using predictive, statistical models, etc
Funnel testing for reach, comparison, conversion (micro-included), and then internal LTV testing, Click- to-Call systems assessment, iSpot Analysis for TV/OTT (reach) campaigns
Built complex Tableau dashboards for Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing Ads, etc). I helped convert their Power BI dashboards to Tableau. We switched for a very specific reason

Used Python, DataBricks, SQL, Excel (blended data), and Funnel.io to create a customized reporting system that automated and ensured accuracy to all of the marketing channels we have. It collected data automatically from 10+ channels (platforms) on a weekly basis

Using regression models based on previous year and previous periods, we were able to very accurately predict the outcome of the types of tests we used: hold-out, geo-promotional offers, scale-ups, scale-downs, reallocation of funds to different channels, etc.

Successfully achieved goals which were to get 4 times the volume (800k/month) at a 3.5 ROAS (return on ad spend). Our marketing campaigns before I started were at 200k/month at a 1.5 ROAS
